title: Concept: Tenant identifier crosswalk in a response
description: A tenant identifier returned beside a customer identifier in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The pair maps a customer to the tenant that owns them, which is the key an attacker needs to move between tenants if any downstream check trusts the tenant field.
applicability: Deployments that render a tenant identifier returned beside a customer identifier into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The pair maps a customer to the tenant that owns them, which is the key an attacker needs to move between tenants if any downstream check trusts the tenant field.
